tasks.gr9-business-responsibility-integration-: Topic: Business responsibility and integration. Cover labour responsibility (wages, working conditions, legal rights), corporate social responsibility, business ethics, South African labour law, responsibilities to employees, customers and society. Ask Grade 9 learners to assess business responsibility, analyse labour law compliance, identify stakeholder impacts, evaluate ethical decisions, and explain CSR integration into business strategy.
tasks.gr9-exam-revision-preparation-t4: Topic: Exam revision and preparation. Cover case study analysis, concept integration across all terms, exam strategies (time management, reading questions, defining terms, justifying answers, providing evidence). Ask Grade 9 learners to analyse complex case studies, apply multiple concepts, justify integrated business decisions, use examples effectively, and demonstrate mastery across economic systems, entrepreneurship, financials, marketing and responsibility.
